dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at this video! Strange lights over Bangkok last night!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ðɪs ˈvɪdioʊ! ˈstreɪndʒ ˈlaɪts ˈoʊvər ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈlæst ˈnaɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let me see… Hmm. They're all moving together.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈsiː… ˈhm. ðɛr ˈɔːl ˈmuːvɪŋ təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's a UFO! Aliens are visiting Bangkok!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˌjuː ɛf ˈoʊ! ˈeɪliənz ər ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ ˈbæŋkɑːk!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fah, it can't be a spaceship. They're probably drones.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑː, ɪt ˈkænt bi ə ˈspeɪsʃɪp. ðɛr ˈprɑːbəbli ˈdroʊnz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Drones? There are hundreds of them!
dialogue.reading: ˈdroʊnz? ðɛr ər ˈhʌndrədz əv ˈðɛm!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. It must be a drone show.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ɪt mʌst bi ə ˈdroʊn ˌʃoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You're no fun. I'm a believer! Millions of people have seen UFOs.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈnoʊ ˈfʌn. aɪm ə bɪˈliːvər! ˈmɪljənz əv ˈpiːpəl hæv ˈsiːn ˌjuː ɛf ˈoʊz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Seeing something isn't the same as proving it.
dialogue.reading: ˈsiːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈɪzənt ðə ˈseɪm əz ˈpruːvɪŋ ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, then prove that aliens aren't real.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈðɛn ˈpruːv ðæt ˈeɪliənz ˈɑːrənt ˈriːəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I can't. But there's no scientific evidence that they've visited our planet.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkænt. bʌt ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk ˈɛvədəns ðæt ðeɪv ˈvɪzɪtɪd aʊr ˈplænɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That can't be true. The government is hiding it!
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈkænt bi ˈtruː. ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ɪz ˈhɪdɪŋ ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fah, you've been watching too many videos again!
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑː, juːv bɪn ˈwɑːtʃɪŋ ˈtuː ˈmɛni ˈvɪdioʊz əˈɡɛn!
